card.name: Start of 'unsound' after an adverb
card.fires_on: The 'uns' start of words like unsound, unsupervised, unsanitary, unsophisticated, right after an adverb such as structurally, environmentally or medically. It predicts that the word will finish as 'sound'.

modes.label: uns- after adverb
modes.description: The 'uns' piece begins an un- word after an adverb, most clearly 'unsound'.
modes.example: it is unlawful and environmentally<< uns>>ound to use the pesticide in any manner

modes.description: Weaker cases where a word starting with s is split, such as supersede or says.

card.writes: It promotes 'sound' and its forms, so it pushes the model to complete the word as 'sound'.
card.plain: It fires when a word like 'unsound' has just begun and the model expects 'sound' to come next.
